FIELDS.NAME: Paws & Claws Pet Store and Grooming
FIELDS.DESCRIPTION OF OPERATIONS:
At Paws & Claws Pet Store and Grooming, we specialize in providing high-quality products and services for common domestic animals, primarily dogs and cats. Our core operations include a retail pet store offering a variety of pet supplies, food, toys, and accessories, as well as a comprehensive pet grooming service. We emphasize the importance of safety and animal welfare, which is why all our staff undergo documented training in animal handling and grooming practices. Our facilities are designed with secure enclosures and non-slip flooring to create a safe environment for both pets and customers. We adhere to the highest standards of cleanliness and ventilation to ensure a healthy atmosphere. With over three years in operation, we have established a reputation for excellent customer service and care for pets, focusing solely on common domestic animals and avoiding service for aggressive or exotic species.

Our pet store specializes in a variety of exotic animals, including reptiles and large birds, and we also offer grooming services for all types of pets, including those known for their assertive behavior.
FIELDS.DESCRIPTION OF LOSSES: No losses reported; however, our operations do not involve any aggressive or exotic animals to ensure compliance with insurance requirements.
